indications.name: In combination with nucleos(t)ide analog reverse transcriptase inhibitor (NrtI) therapy for treatment of chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection in adult patients without cirrhosis

pivotal.indication: In combination with nucleos(t)ide analog reverse transcriptase inhibitor (NrtI) therapy for treatment of chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection in adult patients without cirrhosis
pivotal.checkedBy: Overnight agent 2026-10-30: Confirmed by label section 14 and the registry record.

evidence.quote: The efficacy of HIBSAGO in the treatment of chronic HBV infection was evaluated in two multi-center, Phase 3, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trials with identical designs (B-Well 1 [NCT05630807] and B-Well 2 [NCT05630820]).
